card.name: Linking words before drug class names
card.fires_on: Small linking words (of, an, a, either) and hyphen pieces right before a named drug or drug class, such as furosemide, alpha blocker, or alpha-adrenergic. Seen in interaction and warning passages.

modes.label: Linking word before a drug
modes.description: A word like of, an, a or either that comes just before a drug or drug class name or a clinical effect.
modes.example: can reduce the natriuretic effect<< of>> furosemide and thiazides

modes.label: Hyphen piece inside class names
modes.description: A hyphen or first piece of a compound drug class name, such as alpha-adrenergic or non-dihydropyridine.
modes.example: as adjunctive therapy to alpha<<-ad>>renergic blockade

card.plain: It fires on small connecting words just before a drug or drug class name is about to appear.
